custody_model: Custodial exchange-hosted staking. Current reviewed U.S. and European Uphold staking terms state that users retain ownership of eligible cryptoassets while staked and that the assets remain user property; U.S. terms additionally state beneficial ownership remains unaffected while Uphold retains custodial responsibility. Geographic terms vary and these statements are not generalized beyond the reviewed applicable terms.
yield_source: Rewards are based on staking eligible cryptoassets in the relevant third-party proof-of-stake network and are determined by that network rather than promised as a fixed return by CYA.
risk_notes: Risks include protocol and validator performance, slashing, unbonding and liquidity delays, custodial/platform exposure, market volatility and geographic/regulatory restrictions. Boosted or fixed-duration variants may add lock-up constraints.

custody_model: Exchange-hosted ETH staking using an independent-node model. First-party materials state that each client's assets are staked to a dedicated independent node. HashKey's disclosure identifies HashKey Cloud/Wancloud Limited as a node validation provider in its staking infrastructure. Reviewed public materials do not establish a universal legal-title, segregation or insolvency-treatment conclusion.
yield_source: Ethereum proof-of-stake network rewards generated by the independent validator node, less HashKey Exchange's stated 20% service fee. Rewards are explicitly not fixed and depend on network reward rates, node uptime and validator performance.
risk_notes: Risks include validator and operational failure, slashing, Ethereum staking and unstaking queue delays, changing network reward rates, platform/custody exposure and unresolved legal-title or insolvency treatment in the reviewed public materials.
